harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1 (Alpine 3.23), built a local apk repository from packages fetched to local disk storage, served it over HTTP via darkhttpd bound to the node's own IP, then made the usual remote repo (dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org) unreachable via a /etc/hosts blackhole entry, and successfully installed the mtr package (plus its jansson dependency) using only the local repository while the remote was confirmed unreachable. Restored normal repo/hosts config afterward, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id and health, issued a delayed reboot so the ack returned first, polled until node1 came back, confirmed the boot_id changed, and verified the installed package, local repo artifacts (byte-identical via md5), and restored remote-repo reachability all survived the restart.
actions_performed: Captured baseline: OS/arch, apk repo config, boot_id, confirmed mtr not installed and remote CDN reachable
Fetched mtr + dependency .apk files into /srv/localrepo/x86_64 while network was up, built unsigned APKINDEX.tar.gz

Discovered busybox on this image has no httpd applet; installed darkhttpd from the still-reachable remote repo and started it as a detached daemon serving /srv/localrepo on $NODE_IP:8080, verified 200 response

Blackholed dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org via /etc/hosts, verified remote repo request times out (unreachable), pointed /etc/apk/repositories exclusively at the local HTTP repo, ran apk update/add --allow-untrusted, installed and verified mtr
Restored /etc/apk/repositories and /etc/hosts to original content; verified remote reachable again and mtr still installed
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, uptime, package health, local repo file md5)
Issued delayed sudo -n reboot so the exec ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until command execution resumed; confirmed boot_id changed from 3587c063-ef4b-4fff-9bf7-ee49f6989bd8 to b7634457-2ee2-472f-9896-53e94b30cbe5
Verified post-restart: mtr still installed and runs, local repo apk file md5 unchanged, apk repositories config normal, remote CDN reachable again, no leftover hosts blackhole entry

evidence.requirement: Serve a package repository from local storage on node1
evidence.summary: Fetched mtr and deps into /srv/localrepo/x86_64, built APKINDEX.tar.gz, and started darkhttpd serving that directory on $NODE_IP:8080 with a verified HTTP 200 response to the index file.

evidence.requirement: Usual remote repositories unreachable during install
evidence.summary: Added a /etc/hosts blackhole entry for dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org; curl to the remote index timed out (http_code=000, 'REMOTE_UNREACHABLE'), confirming the usual repo was unreachable at install time.

evidence.requirement: Install a package from the local repository while remote is unreachable
evidence.summary: With /etc/apk/repositories pointed only at http://$NODE_IP:8080 and the remote blackholed, apk update --allow-untrusted and apk add --allow-untrusted mtr succeeded; apk info -e mtr and mtr --version confirmed the install.

evidence.requirement: Node restored to normal (non-disruptive) state after demonstration
evidence.summary: Restored original /etc/apk/repositories and /etc/hosts; confirmed remote repo reachable again (http_code=200) and mtr remained installed.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (3587c063-ef4b-4fff-9bf7-ee49f6989bd8), uptime, working mtr binary, and md5 of the local repo's mtr apk file as baseline evidence.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: single-node reboot with returned acknowledgement
evidence.summary: Issued a detached delayed 'sudo -n reboot' which acknowledged (REBOOT_SCHEDULED) before the connection was lost on the next poll, confirming the node went down.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: proof of changed boot identity
evidence.summary: After several connection-refused/timeout polls, node1 responded again with uptime '0 min' and a new boot_id b7634457-2ee2-472f-9896-53e94b30cbe5, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, proving an actual reboot occurred.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: post-restart recovery of services/data
evidence.summary: Post-restart: mtr package still installed and functional (mtr --version), local repo apk file md5 unchanged from baseline, apk repositories file back to normal remote config, remote CDN reachable (http_code=200), and no leftover /etc/hosts blackhole entry.
